body.name: Eval
body.def: For \(p\in\Omega_H\), \(\operatorname{Eval}(F,p)=F_b(p)\) for any branch \(b\) whose guard contains \(p\); guard coverage ensures existence, and the certified common-value condition on every overlap makes the value independent of the chosen branch. Evaluation shares common subexpressions and divides only by denominators certified positive on the chosen guard.
body.role: Turns a returned circuit into the identified target vector.
